title: BEAP BatchItemOutcome
description: One item's outcome within an authorized batch (specification section 22.11). Outcomes are attributable to the canonical item digest of the item in the authorized Batch Manifest, never to a downstream reference, so an outcome cannot introduce an item the approvers never bound. The item outcomes digest a BatchEffectEvidence record carries is the SHA-256 digest of the RFC 8785 canonical form of the array of these objects, ordered by item_digest in ascending byte order. An outcome whose provider reference is not known omits provider_reference rather than carrying it as null, so that one set of outcomes has exactly one canonical form.
